text:
alex: Heads-up — after the canary flip of idle_timeout=30s we see a rise in duplicate tokens emitted on streaming responses. Spike ~12% in us-east.

tara: Confirmed. Console shows lots of reconnects; rate graph up at 11:52. Billing shows extra tokens but no reconnect_reason tag :grimacing:.

alex: Suspect client reconnect vs resume mismatch. If client reconnects before the resume window is accepted, router falls back to variant v1-light and we re-issue the full generation.

kevin: Any trace ids/samples? Can we repro with curl?

alex: Example trace fragment:```
[trace] req=abc123 route=pool-2 -> pick v1-light
[stream] kvcache: miss resume_id=null
[emit] tokens=full_response duplicate=true
```

anya: We saw something similar last month but different root cause. The difference here is the console rollout added an "early_probe" that restarts connections on pingback_timeout. Could be triggering immediate reconnects.

tara: So two gaps: 1) routing decision lacks a `resume_candidate` tag in telemetry, 2) console UX doesn't surface `reconnect_reason` in the per-route dashboard. Ops can't correlate traces -> billing.

alex: Quick proposal: 
- add `reconnect_reason` enum to request traces (client_initiated, heartbeat_miss, proxy_early_close)
- tag routing decision with `resume_candidate=true/false`
- rollback the canary idle_timeout->30s to 60s until we patch telemetry

kevin: I can add trace tags in the router but that'll touch trace.v1 schema. Will open PR. Also suggest sampling full payload traces for 1% of reconnects (so we can inspect token diffs).

devops-bot: Created ticket INF-4821: "Add reconnect_reason + resume_candidate tags; revert idle_timeout canary" — assignees: @kevin, @alex. ETA: 2d.

alex: Thx. Also request console: add a chart breakdown by reconnect_reason and link example traces from the panel. That'll massively speed triage.

tara: Agreed — I'll draft the console UX (mock charts + probe filter) and drop in the ticket. :eyes:

kevin: Starting router PR now. Will feature-flag the trace tags so rollout is safe.

devops-bot: Note: alert "streaming_duplicate_tokens" silenced for canary window; will re-enable after rollback or fix.
